_comment: The one variable, as data. current_date anchors every age computation -- fixed forever, never datetime.now(). qualitative maps age_days to a T-shirt label per issue #62 part 3: <7d fresh (label omitted), 7-30d 'old', >30d 'very old'. status_threshold_days gates the status line at the same >30d boundary as the very-old bucket, on purpose -- the two richer conditions agree on what counts as stale.
